text: Walk me through your career so far and what led you to apply for this role.
What accomplishment from your career are you most proud of, and why?
What part of your previous experience do you think prepares you best for this position?
Tell me about a project where your specific skill set made the biggest difference to the outcome.
What best practices do you follow to make sure your work is reliable and maintainable over time?
How do you stay current with new tools, methods, or trends in your field?
What's a concept in your field that you think is commonly misunderstood, and how would you explain it correctly?
How do you decide between two competing approaches when solving a technical problem?
Describe a time you disagreed with a coworker or manager about how to handle something. How did you resolve it?
Tell me about a time you had to meet a tight deadline with limited resources. What did you do?
How would you handle a situation where a project's priorities suddenly changed midway through?
Describe a time you had to deliver bad news to a stakeholder or client. How did you approach it?
If you had to remove one everyday object from the world, which would you choose and how would people adapt?
How would you explain a complex idea from your field to a curious 10-year-old?
You're given a task with no clear instructions and no one to ask. Walk me through how you'd figure out what to do.
If you could redesign one everyday process to make it more efficient, what would it be and how?
Walk me through how you would evaluate whether a new initiative was actually successful.
Describe a time you used data to challenge an assumption or change a decision.
How do you approach a problem when the available data is incomplete or messy?
Tell me about a time you had to choose between several options with limited information. How did you decide?
